title: Shattered Items
description: Items Shatter instead of breaking, and can be repaired with XP!
body:
# Shattered Items
Shattered Items is a simple plugin that shatters items instead of letting them break, when the item breaks, they will stay with the player but marked as **Shattered**. The item becomes useless, you can't attack, break blocks, interact, wear (For Armor), enchant, craft, or smelt with it, it becomes completely useless till it's repaired in the `/repairer`

Repairing a shattered item costs xp, for each 8 damage is on the item, it will cost 1 xp, so for example, a diamond hoe got 1561 durability, which will cost 195 XP to repair

## Simplicity
This plugin is fully developed, you can put the jar in your plugins folder and it's ready to be used. 

## Permissions
- `shattereditems.repairhand` - Get access to `/repairer repairhand` which repairs the held item for free
